problem: Reviewing large folders of PDF/Word resumes manually is slow and inconsistent. User needs automatic bulk filtering against experience and keyword criteria with explainable per-resume results.
goal: Enable hiring managers to bulk-screen a local folder of PDF/DOCX resumes by minimum experience and required keywords, with explainable Qualified / Not Qualified / Undetermined results, qualified copies in a Jalali-dated output folder, a single-sheet Excel report, and a UI summary.

needs: bulk-filter resumes by experience and skills
understand why each resume qualified or not
get qualified files plus full report

inScope: local folder path input (same-machine backend filesystem)
minimum-years-experience criterion (optional, approximate total, unknown preserved)
required technologies/keywords criterion (optional, multi-add, fuzzy case-insensitive)
bulk analysis of top-level PDF and DOCX in English/Persian
Jalali-dated output folder with collision suffix, qualified copies only
single-sheet .xlsx report with summary header plus per-resume rows
UI chunked progress (10 at a time) with cancel/pause plus final summary and output path
outOfScope: cloud storage, remote URLs, email ingestion
future criteria: education, university, location, language proficiency, job titles, companies/industries, per-skill experience, include/exclude sets

features.name: Local folder selection
features.description: User supplies local folder path on server machine; app validates readability and scans only top-level PDF/DOCX.

features.name: Screening criteria configuration
features.description: Optional individually, at least one required to start: min years experience (number) and multiple required keywords with add-more UI; extensible for future criteria.

features.name: Resume text extraction and analysis
features.description: Extract name, estimated total experience, technologies/skills from text-based PDF/DOCX in English/Persian; lightweight fuzzy keyword matching ignoring case/spacing/punctuation and common aliases.

features.name: Three-way qualification engine
features.description: AND logic over active criteria; Qualified vs Not Qualified vs Undetermined; unknown experience maps to Undetermined with reason text, never silent reject.

features.name: Jalali-dated output folder with qualified copies
features.description: Auto-create resume-screening-output-YYYY-MM-DD (Jalali) inside source folder; on collision append -1, -2 keeping all runs; copy only qualified files; never modify/delete originals.

features.name: Single-sheet Excel report
features.description: One .xlsx in output folder: top summary block (totals, qualified, not qualified, undetermined, criteria used, screening Jalali/Gregorian date) then one row per processed resume with fixed columns.

features.name: Progress and summary UI
features.description: Chunked processing (10 at a time) with progress bar, pause/cancel controls; post-run summary counts plus output folder path; empty-folder error creates no output.

features.name: Offline cross-platform operation
features.description: No internet required; runs on Windows and Linux (plus macOS); pluggable criteria design so new criteria add without workflow redesign.

acceptanceCriteria.given: backend and resume folder on same machine
acceptanceCriteria.when: user submits a readable local folder path
acceptanceCriteria.then: app accepts it and counts top-level .pdf/.docx files only, ignoring subfolders and other extensions

acceptanceCriteria.given: criteria form with min-experience empty and no keywords
acceptanceCriteria.then: start is blocked with message requiring at least one criterion

acceptanceCriteria.given: min experience 5 set and resume estimates 7 years
acceptanceCriteria.then: experience check passes and 7 years plus pass reason recorded

acceptanceCriteria.given: min experience 5 set and resume estimates 3 years
acceptanceCriteria.then: resume marked Not Qualified with reason failing 5-year requirement

acceptanceCriteria.given: experience criterion active but resume has insufficient dates to estimate
acceptanceCriteria.then: experience status Unknown, final status Undetermined, reason states experience could not be determined

acceptanceCriteria.when: resume mentions only Vue.js and Angular without React
acceptanceCriteria.then: React recorded missing and keyword check fails

acceptanceCriteria.given: required keywords React, Material UI, TypeScript
acceptanceCriteria.when: resume contains react, React.js, differing case/spacing variants
acceptanceCriteria.then: matching is case-insensitive and tolerant of spacing/punctuation and common aliases

acceptanceCriteria.given: password-protected, corrupt, or scanned-image PDF with no extractable text
acceptanceCriteria.then: resume marked Undetermined with could-not-analyze reason, included in report counts, never copied to output
new folder inside source named resume-screening-output-YYYY-MM-DD using Persian/Jalali date is created
app appends -1, -2 suffix keeping all prior runs instead of overwriting
only Qualified files are copied, originals unmodified and undeleted

single .xlsx in output folder contains summary block (total found, processed, qualified, not qualified, undetermined, criteria used, screening date) followed by per-resume table with filename, candidate name, estimated years, experience status, technologies detected, required found, required missing, final status, reason
every processed resume including Not Qualified and Undetermined appears as one row
app processes in chunks of 10 with visible progress bar and working pause and cancel controls
UI shows found, processed, qualified, not qualified, undetermined counts plus output folder path
UI shows no-resumes error and creates no output folder or report

acceptanceCriteria.given: machine without internet on Windows or Linux
acceptanceCriteria.then: full flow works offline without external calls

constraints: Backend reads local server filesystem path; no browser upload.
PDF and DOCX text-based only; no OCR in v1.
Jalali date folder format YYYY-MM-DD; Excel .xlsx single sheet.
Top-level files only; no subfolder recursion.
Chunk size 10 with progress, pause, cancel.
assumptions: User supplies absolute or relative readable local path.
Single-sheet layout: summary rows at top, then header row plus per-resume rows on same sheet.
Pause resumes the chunked queue; cancel stops remaining files but preserves partial output and report for processed files.
